allowed_development_data: post-hoc adversarial-v5 no-evidence failure taxonomy; v5 is historical diagnostic only

architecture.answerability_layer: deterministic proposition and slot coverage with contradiction/uncertainty resolution
architecture.counterfactual_rule: Do not require multiple supporting memories. Use counterfactual logic only to reject apparent support that is solely query echo, boilerplate, or duplicated non-answer evidence.
features: fail-closed fallback for unseen requested attributes
architecture.integration_rule: If verdict is SUPPORTED, return the original frozen Candidate-v2 ranking unchanged. Otherwise return [].
architecture.retriever: pse_candidate_v2_rank frozen comparator; no ranking-semantic modification

confirmatory_rule: v5 MUST NOT be reused as Candidate-v4 confirmatory evidence. Only after validation PASS may a new mechanism-agnostic adversarial-v6 benchmark be created and frozen before system execution.
forbidden_data: any future adversarial-v6 confirmatory results before v4 freeze
validation outcomes for tuning after the one-time frozen validation
paid or external private evaluation data
freeze_rule: Only after development PASS, freeze one source/config/protocol identity and commit it before the one-time protected validation.
negative_result_rule: If one-time frozen validation fails, Candidate-v4 is REJECTED and must not be patched; any new method becomes Candidate-v5.
research_question: Can a post-retrieval answerability mechanism distinguish relevant-looking evidence from evidence sufficient to answer, while preserving frozen Candidate-v2 retrieval quality?
statistics_rule: Future v6 primary comparisons use 10,000 paired bootstrap iterations for v4-v2 and v4-exact-A-MEM; abstention/error rates report Wilson 95% CIs.
